A '''survey gear''' was a type of headwear used primarily by [[Peragus II|Peragian]] [[Miner/Legends|miners]] who were surveying new [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] claims. It was designed to help identify both pockets of [[Gas/Legends|gas]] and any [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal charges]] placed in the area. The helmet also included small sonic generation and receiving gear in order to absorb any high decibel emissions from [[Sonic grenade/Legends|sonic charges]] and [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]].
